blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cells ki do basic qismein hain: prokaryotic aur eukaryotic. Tamam bacteria prokaryotes hain. Yeast aur Euglena unicellular (ek cell wale) eukaryotes ki misalen hain. Poday aur janwar multicellular (bohat se cells wale) eukaryotes ki misalen hain. Eukaryotic cells prokaryotic cells se zyada pecheeda (complex) hote hain. Agle paragraphs mein hum cell ke andar ki structures (banawatein) aur un ke kaam parhenge.
Cell Wall

Cell wall cell ke gird ek kam-o-besh sakht (solid) tah (layer) hai. Yeh bacteria, fungi, podon aur algae mein milti hai. Agar cell wall ko aise enzymes se hata diya jaye jo cell wall ko tor dete hain, to cell ka baqi hissa protoplast kehlata hai.

Primary wall cell ki asal cell wall hai. Yeh polysaccharides (lambi sugar chains) se bani hai: cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin. Cellulose microfibrils (bareek dhage) har zaviye (angle) par phaile hote hain aur hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain. Primary wall mein bohat se proteins bhi hote hain. Middle lamella ek gelatinous (jelly jaisi) tah hai jo parosi (neighbouring) cells ki primary walls ko alag bhi karti hai aur jor kar bhi rakhti hai. Yeh sab se pehle banti hai: cytokinesis (cytoplasm ki taqseem) ke dauran cell plate se banti hai, aur phir primary wall middle lamella ke andar ki taraf phailti hai. Is mein magnesium aur calcium pectates (pectic acid ke salts) hote hain. Kuch poday ke cells mein jawan (mature) hone ke baad protoplast aur primary wall ke darmiyan secondary wall banti hai. Secondary wall mein lignin, cellulose aur hemicellulose hote hain. Lignin ki wajah se secondary wall primary wall se zyada sakht (rigid) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Poday ki cell wall ki qash: sab se oopar middle lamella, darmiyan mein primary cell wall aur neeche plasma membrane. Primary wall mein cellulose microfibrils qataron mein hain, kuch lambai mein aur kuch kate hue; cross-linking glycans parosi microfibrils ko aapas mein bandhte hain, aur lehrdar pectin dhaage un ke beech ki jagah bharte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5: Primary cell wall ki tarkeeb (composition) (textbook ki Figure 3.5 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Primary wall ek jaal jaisi hai: cellulose microfibrils mazboot sariye (rods) hain, cross-linking glycans unhein jorne wali rassiyan hain, aur pectin un ke beech gond (glue) jaisi bharai hai. Middle lamella do parosi cells ko jorti hai. Secondary wall (lignin wali) is figure mein nahin; woh baad mein primary wall ke andar ki taraf banti hai.

Plasmodesmata (wahid: plasmodesma): yeh chhote channels (naliyan) hain jo parosi poday ke cells ke cytoplasm ko seedha aapas mein jorte hain. Plasmodesmata primary aur secondary dono cell walls mein se guzarte hain. Yeh kuch molecules ko ek cell se doosre cell mein seedha jane dete hain, is liye cells ke aapas ke rabte (communication) ke liye aham hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar parosi poday ke cells, har ek mein cytoplasm, nucleus aur vacuole, jo apni primary walls aur sanjhi middle lamella se alag hain; walls ke aar-paar chhote channels (plasmodesmata) cells ko jorte hain. Ek plasmodesma ki bari ki hui tasveer mein channel plasma membrane, primary wall, middle lamella, primary wall aur plasma membrane se guzarta hai, aur plasma membrane channel ki andar ki satah bana kar dono cells ko mila deti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Do parosi cells ki cell walls aur un mein ek plasmodesma (textbook ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Plasmodesmata ki wajah se scientists mein cell theory par behas hui hai. Kuch scientists kehte hain ke higher (taraqqi yafta) podon ke cells asal mein alag cells nahi, kyun ke woh ek doosre se jismani taur par alag ya azaad nahi.

Diatoms naam ke algae ka group apni cell wall silicic acid se banata hai. Yeh acid cell ke andar polymerize (chhote units jur kar bara molecule) hota hai, phir wall bahar nikal kar cell ki hifazat karti hai. Silica ki wall banane mein kam energy lagti hai, isi liye diatoms tezi se barhte hain.
Plasmodesmata cell division ke dauran bante hain, jab parent cell ke endoplasmic reticulum ke kuch hisse nayi cell wall mein phans jate hain.

Cell wall ke kai kaam hain: yeh cell ko sakhti (rigidity) deti hai taake banawat aur mechanical sahara mile; cell ki shakal aur us ke barhne ki simt (direction) qaim rakhti hai, aur aakhir mein poore poday ki banawat banati hai. Jab pani cell mein aata hai to cell wall cell ko had se zyada phoolne nahi deti. Cell wall pathogens (beemari phailane wale jaraseem) aur mahol se hifazat karti hai aur poday ke liye carbohydrates ka zakheera (store) bhi hai.

Algae ki cell wall mein cellulose aur kai qisam ke glycoproteins hote hain.
Fungi ki cell wall chitin se bani hai; yeh wohi carbohydrate hai jo keeron (insects) ke exoskeleton (bahar ka sakht dhancha) ko mazboot banata hai.
Prokaryotes (bacteria aur cyanobacteria) ki cell wall peptidoglycan se bani hai, jo amino acids aur sugar ka ek bara polymer hai.
Archaebacteria ki cell wall mukhtalif polysaccharides aur proteins se bani hai; is mein peptidoglycan nahi hota.

blocks.text: Plasma Membrane

Tamam prokaryotic aur eukaryotic cells mein plasma membrane hoti hai jo cell ke andar ki cheezon ko ghere rakhti hai aur bahar ke mahol ke samne semi-porous (kuch cheezon ko guzarne dene wali) rukawat (barrier) ka kaam karti hai.
Structure of plasma membrane (plasma membrane ki banawat)

Fluid mosaic model aam taur par mana hua khayal hai jo batata hai ke plasma membrane hamesha harkat mein (dynamic) rehti hai. Yeh model 1972 mein do American biologists S.J. Singer aur Garth Nicolson ne pesh kiya. Is model ke mutabiq plasma membrane ki bunyad lipid bilayer (lipids ki do tahein) hai. Yeh bilayer phospholipids se bani hai, aur is mein bohat se proteins tairte rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Nucleus wala ek chhota cell plasma membrane ke bare kiye hue hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai: phospholipid bilayer jis mein channel protein, globular protein, carbohydrate chain wala glycolipid, carbohydrate wala glycoprotein, andar ki satah par peripheral protein aur surface protein, bilayer ke aar-paar globular integral protein, phospholipids ke beech cholesterol aur integral protein hain. Insets mein lipid bilayer aur ek phospholipid ka hydrophilic head aur hydrophobic tail dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.7: Plasma membrane ke banawati hisse (textbook ki Figure 3.7 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phospholipid ka sar (head) pani pasand (hydrophilic) hai aur dum (tail) pani se door bhagti hai (hydrophobic), is liye do tahein ban jati hain: sar bahar pani ki taraf, dumein andar. Proteins is tel jaisi tah mein tairte hain (fluid mosaic). Carbohydrate chains sirf bahar ki satah par proteins (glycoprotein) aur lipids (glycolipid) se jurti hain.

Har phospholipid molecule ke ek sire par phosphate group hota hai. Phospholipid ka phosphate wala sira hydrophilic (pani pasand) hai, aur C-H chains wali dum (tail) hydrophobic (pani se door bhagne wali) hai. Is liye lipid bilayer mein hydrophobic dumein andar ki taraf aur hydrophilic phosphate sire bahar ki taraf hote hain: ek taraf cell ke cytoplasm ki janib, doosri taraf cell ke bahar ke mahol ki janib.

Lipid bilayer ka andar ka hissa hydrophobic hai. Yeh pani mein ghulne wale (water-soluble) molecules ko guzarne nahi deta. Agar cell sirf khalis lipid bilayer mein band hota to sugars aur polar amino acids jaise water-soluble molecules bilkul andar na ja sakte. Isi liye membrane mein phospholipids ke saath proteins bhi hain jo membrane ke aar-paar raste dete hain.

Eukaryotes ki plasma membrane mein phospholipid bilayer ke beech cholesterol molecules phanse hote hain. Yeh kam temperature par bhi membrane ki fluidity (bahao/naram-pan) qaim rakhte hain. Bohat se proteins phospholipid bilayer mein tairte hain, aur kuch proteins sirf bilayer ki satah (surface) se chipke rehte hain. Proteins ki jagah cytoskeleton ki tarteeb se juri hoti hai. Plasma membrane ke proteins kai tarah ke kaam karte hain:

items: Bohat se proteins kuch khaas cheezon ko chun kar (selective transport) phospholipid bilayer ke aar-paar le jate hain; yeh channels ya active transport molecules ka kaam karte hain.
Kuch proteins plasma membrane ko cytoskeleton aur bahar ke fibres se jorne mein madad karte hain.
Bahar ki satah par kuch proteins sugars se jur kar pehchan ke nishan (identification marks) banate hain.
Kuch proteins receptors hain: yeh messenger molecules (jaise hormones) ko pakarte hain aur signal cell ke andar pohanchate hain.
Kuch proteins enzyme ka kaam bhi karte hain aur plasma membrane se jure reactions ko tez (catalyse) karte hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif cells ko pehchan kar alag karna zindagi ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Is se embryo (bachay ki ibtidai shakal) ke cells khud ko tissues aur organs mein tarteeb dete hain. Is se immune system ke cells bahar ke cells, jaise infection karne wale bacteria, ko pehchan kar rad (reject) karte hain.

blocks.alt: Extracellular space (oopar) aur cytosol (neeche) ke darmiyan membrane mein chaar qisam ke proteins: transporters (channel aur carrier jo chhote molecules ko paar le jate hain), anchors (proteins jo bahar ke fibres aur andar ke cytoskeleton se bandhe hain), receptors (protein jo bahar signal molecule pakar kar signal andar bhejta hai) aur enzymes (protein jo reaction, x se y, tez karta hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 3.8: Plasma membrane proteins ki bari qismein (textbook ki Figure 3.8 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
Percent by weight (wazan ke hisab se fisad)

blocks.text: Is table se pata chalta hai ke har membrane mein protein aur lipid ki miqdar alag hai. Mitochondria ki andar wali membrane mein protein sab se zyada (76%) hai, kyun ke wahan electron transport chain aur ATP-synthase ke bohat se proteins hote hain. Carbohydrate sirf red blood cell ki membrane mein hai (8%), jo bahar ki satah ke glycoproteins aur glycolipids mein hota hai.
blocks.title: Table ko samjhein

blocks.text: Plasma membrane ki bahar ki satah par sugars ki chains proteins aur lipids se juri hoti hain. Jis protein se sugar juri ho use glycoprotein kehte hain, aur jis lipid se sugar juri ho use glycolipid. Glycoproteins aur glycolipids har species mein alag hote hain, ek hi species ke har fard mein alag, balke ek hi fard ke mukhtalif qisam ke cells mein bhi alag hote hain. Glycolipids aur glycoproteins ko mila kar glycocalyx kehte hain; yeh cell ke pehchan ke nishan hain jinhen doosre cells pehchante hain.
Functions of plasma membrane (plasma membrane ke kaam)

Plasma membrane bahar ke mahol ke samne semi-porous rukawat hai. Yeh ek boundary (had) ki tarah cell ke saare hisson ko ikattha rakhti hai. Lekin yeh kuch khaas molecules ke liye permeable (guzarne dene wali) hai: nutrients aur doosre zaroori elements ko andar aane deti hai aur waste ko bahar jane deti hai. Chhote molecules, jaise oxygen, carbon dioxide aur pani, aasani se aar-paar guzar jate hain, lekin bare molecules, jaise amino acids aur sugars, ka guzarna ehtiyat se control hota hai. Eukaryotic cells mein kuch andar ke organelles ke gird bhi membranes hoti hain. Bahar ki plasma membrane ki tarah yeh membranes bhi organelles mein cheezon ke aane jane ko control karti hain.
Techniques to study the structure of plasma membrane (membrane ki banawat parhne ke tareeqe)

items: Transmission Electron Microscopy lipid bilayer aur us se jure proteins ki tafseeli banawat dikha sakti hai.
Scanning Electron Microscopy cells aur membranes ki surface ki shakal (topology) dekhne ke liye mufeed hai.
Confocal Microscopy laser scanning aur fluorescence (roshni chhorna) se cell membrane ki tez aur saaf tasweeren banati hai.
Total Internal Reflection Fluorescence Microscopy membrane, aur cytoskeleton aur cell ke doosre hisson ke saath us ke rabte ki high-resolution tasweeren deti hai.
Atomic Force Microscopy cell membrane ki satah ke utaar-charhao (topography) ki high-resolution tasweeren deti hai.
X-ray Crystallography se membrane proteins ki atomic structure (atoms ki tarteeb) maloom ki jati hai.
Lipidomics mein mass spectrometry jaisi techniques se cell membrane ke lipids ka mukammal tajziya (analysis) kiya jata hai.

Fluorescence Recovery After Photobleaching se membrane proteins aur lipids ki harkat dekhi jati hai. Membrane ke fluorescent label wale hisse ko laser se bleach (be-rang) kiya jata hai, phir dekha jata hai ke ghair-bleach molecules wahan aa kar dobara kitni jaldi roshni lautate hain.

blocks.text: Cytoplasm and Organelles

Aap jante hain ke cell ke teen bare hisse hain: plasma membrane, cytoplasm aur nucleus. Cytoplasm ek semi-viscous (thora gaarha) aur semi-transparent (thora aar-paar dikhne wala) madda hai. Eukaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane aur nuclear envelope ke darmiyan hota hai. Prokaryotic cells mein yeh plasma membrane ke neeche ki saari jagah bharta hai. Is ka bunyadi pani wala madda cytosol kehlata hai, jis mein organelles aur doosri cheezen hoti hain. Cytosol mein pani hai jis mein bohat se organic madde (proteins, carbohydrates, lipids) aur inorganic salts poori ya kuch had tak ghule hote hain. Cytoplasm organelles ko theek kaam karne ki jagah deta hai aur kai biochemical (metabolic) reactions ki jagah bhi hai, misal ke taur par glycolysis (aerobic respiration mein glucose ka tootna).

Cytoplasm mein alag alag structures hoti hain jo cell ke khaas kaamon ke liye hain; inhen cell organelles kehte hain. Ribosome jaise chand organelles ke ilawa aam taur par organelles membrane mein band hote hain. Agle paragraphs mein aham organelles ki banawat aur kaam bayan kiye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Poday ka cell jo plasmodesmata wali cell wall aur plasma membrane mein band hai. Andar cytoplasm, bari vacuole, chloroplasts, mitochondria, peroxisome, Golgi vesicles ke saath Golgi apparatus, rough aur smooth endoplasmic reticulum, ribosomes, cytoskeleton ke fibres, aur nucleus apni nuclear envelope, nuclear pores aur nucleolus ke saath hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono figures (3.9 aur 3.10) ka muqabla karein: poday ke cell mein cell wall, chloroplasts aur bari central vacuole hai; janwar ke cell mein yeh nahin, magar centrosome (centrioles ka jora) aur lysosomes hain.
1- Nucleus

Tamam eukaryotic cells mein ek numayan (wazeh) nucleus hota hai: janwar ke cell mein darmiyan mein, aur poday ke cell mein ek taraf dhakela hua. Gol nucleus aam taur par eukaryotic cell ke hajam (volume) ka taqreeban 10 percent gherta hai. Yeh cell ka maloomat process karne aur intezam chalane wala markaz (centre) hai. Is ke do bare kaam hain: yeh cell ka hereditary material (wirasati madda, DNA) rakhta hai, aur cell ke kaamon jaise growth, protein synthesis aur cell division ko tarteeb (coordinate) deta hai.

blocks.alt: Khula hua nucleus: nuclear pores wali nuclear envelope chromatin ke dhaagon aur darmiyan ke gehre nucleolus ko gherti hai. Ribosomes se bhari endoplasmic reticulum ki tahein ek taraf lipti hain aur envelope ki bahari membrane se jurri (continuous) hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.11: Nucleus ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.11 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Nucleus ke andar ka semifluid (neem-maye) madda nucleoplasm kehlata hai. Nucleoplasm mein zyada tar nuclear material chromatin hai, jo cell division ke waqt chromosomes ki shakal ikhtiyar karta hai. Nucleus mein ek ya zyada nucleoli bhi hote hain jo ribosomes banate hain.
DNA aur RNA ke building blocks (bunyadi tukre) aur ATP nucleus ke andar ja sakte hain. Nucleoli mein bane ribosomal subunits woh cheezen hain jo nucleus se nikal kar cytoplasm mein ja sakti hain.
The Nuclear Envelope and Nuclear Pores

Nuclear envelope do tahon wali membrane hai jo cell ki zindagi ke zyada tar hisse mein nucleus ke andar ki cheezon ko ghere rakhti hai. Dono tahon ke darmiyan ki jagah perinuclear space kehlati hai aur yeh rough endoplasmic reticulum se juri hoti hai. Cell division ke dauran nuclear envelope toot jata hai, lekin daughter cells mein dobara ban jata hai. Nuclear envelope ki andar ki taraf proteins ki ek tah hai jise nuclear lamina kehte hain; yeh chromatin se jur kar use banawati sahara deti hai.

blocks.alt: Nuclear envelope ki qash: outer aur inner nuclear membranes, aur inner membrane ke neeche nuclear lamina ka jaal. Pore par dono membranes mil jati hain aur nuclear pore complex surakh ko bharta hai: cytoplasm ki taraf ring subunits, deewarein banane wale column subunits, darmiyan mein annular subunits, membranes ke beech ki jagah mein lumenal subunits, aur nucleus ke andar latakti nuclear basket.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.12: Nuclear envelope aur nuclear pore complex ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nuclear pore khula surakh nahin: yeh proteins ka darwaza (pore complex) hai jo chunta hai ke kaun sa molecule andar ya bahar jaye. Basket nucleus ki taraf aur ring subunits cytoplasm ki taraf hain.

Nuclear envelope mein nanhe surakh hain jinhen nuclear pores kehte hain. Yeh pores nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan molecules ke aane jane ko control karte hain. Chhote molecules in se guzar jate hain, aur kuch bare proteins, jaise histones, ko bhi andar jane diya jata hai. Nuclear pore ek pecheeda banawat se bana hai jise nuclear pore complex kehte hain. Is ke kai subunits hain: annular subunit (pore ke andar ki taraf ghera), column subunit (complex ki deewar), ring subunit (column subunit ki bahar ki taraf jura) aur lumenal subunit (pore complex ko nuclear envelope mein jamaye rakhta hai). Complex se bareek fibrils nikal kar nucleus ki taraf tokri (basket) jaisi banawat banate hain.

Jo cells bohat zyada protein banate hain, unhen bohat se ribosomes chahiye hote hain, is liye un ka nucleolus kafi bara hota hai.
Mitosis ke shuru mein cell ka nucleolus ghaib ho jata hai, aur division ke baad NORs se naya nucleolus ban jata hai.
Nucleolus

Nucleolus nucleoplasm mein ek wazeh, gehra rang lene wala (darkly stained) hissa hai. Ek nucleus mein ek ya do nucleoli ho sakte hain. Nucleoli woh subunits banate hain jo mil kar ribosome banate hain. Nucleoli chromosome ki kuch khaas jaghon par bante hain jinhen Nucleolus Organizer Regions (NORs) kehte hain. NORs ka DNA ribosomal RNA (rRNA) ka code rakhta hai.

Nucleolus mein granular (daanedar) aur fibrillar (resha-dar) hisse aur DNA hota hai. Granules mein woh ribosomal subunits hain jo ban chuke hain. Fibrils mein ribosome subunits ka kachcha maal hai, yani rRNA molecules aur un se jure proteins.

blocks.alt: Pores wali nuclear envelope mein band nucleus; is ke darmiyan mein ghana, gehra nucleolus hai aur chromatin ke dhaage us se nucleoplasm mein phailte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.13: Nucleus ke andar nucleolus (textbook ki Figure 3.13 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Chromatin and Chromosomes

Nucleus mein dhage jaise fibres hain jinhen mila kar chromatin kehte hain. Yeh DNA aur proteins se bana hai. Chromatin dekhne mein moti ki mala (beads) jaisa hai; har moti nucleosome kehlata hai. Nucleosome mein DNA ka dhaga chhote proteins, histones, ke group ke gird lipta hota hai.
Har insani cell ke nucleus mein taqreeban 6 feet lamba DNA hai. Yeh 46 alag molecules mein bata hua hai (har ek taqreeban 1.5 inch lamba), har chromosome ke liye ek.

Interphase mein (jab cell apne aam kaam kar raha hota hai) chromatin poore nucleus mein uljhe hue dhagon ki tarah phaila hota hai. Jab cell divide hona shuru karta hai to saare chromatin dhage simat kar (compress ho kar) khaas structures, chromosomes, ban jate hain. Chromosome ki baazu (arms) chromatids kehlati hain aur darmiyani nuqta centromere.

Chromatin do qisam ka hai. Euchromatin genetically active (kaam karne wala) chromatin hai jo proteins banane ke liye RNA transcribe karta hai. Doosri qisam heterochromatin hai; is ka DNA genetically inactive (kaam na karne wala) hota hai.

blocks.alt: DNA ke lipatne ke marahil: nuclear pore ke qareeb nucleus ke andar chromatin; nucleosomes ke coil se bana mota chromatin fibre; nucleosomes, har ek mein DNA histones ke markaz ke gird lipta hai; aur DNA double helix. Saath mein condensed chromosome jis ke do chromatids centromere par jure hain, arms aur siron par telomeres ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.14: Chromatin ka daba (condense) ho kar chromosome banna (textbook ki Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Nuclear pore, Chromatin, Chromatin fiber, Nucleosomes, DNA helix, Histones, Telomere, Centromere, Arm, Condensed chromosome.

blocks.text: Kisi jandar ke cells ke nucleus mein chromosomes ki tadaad har species ke liye muqarrar (species-specific) hai. Insan ke diploid cells (jo gametes nahi) mein 46 chromosomes hain. Kuch cheentiyon (ants) aur roundworms mein yeh tadaad sirf 2 hai, aur Indian fern (Ophioglossum reticulatum) mein hazar se zyada, yani 1,260 chromosomes. Is ka matlab hai ke chromosomes ki tadaad ka jandar ki pecheedgi (complexity) se koi talluq nahi.
2- Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER)

ER chapte thailon (flattened sacs) aur shakhon wali naliyon (branching tubules) ka jaal hai jo poday aur janwar ke cells ke poore cytoplasm mein phaila hota hai. In thailon aur naliyon ko cisternae (wahid: cisterna) kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Nucleus ka hissa apni nuclear envelope aur nuclear pores ke saath. Rough endoplasmic reticulum, ribosomes se bhari chapti cisternae, us ke saath aage peeche mudi hui ek hi musalsal thaili hai jis ki cisternal space nuclear envelope ki jagah mein khulti hai; smooth endoplasmic reticulum ki shaakhdar tubes rough ER se aage chalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.15: Endoplasmic reticulum (textbook ki Figure 3.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure mein dekhein ke ER ki saari cisternae aapas mein aur nuclear envelope se juri hain, is liye ER ka lumen aur envelope ki tahon ke beech ki jagah ek hi khana (compartment) hai.

Membrane ke jismani jor ki wajah se ER ka lumen (andar ki khali jagah) aur nuclear envelope ki tahon ke beech ki jagah ek hi khana (compartment) hai. Is qareebi talluq se ER aur nucleus bohat achhi tarah maloomat share karte hain.

Saari cisternae aapas mein juri hain, is liye ER ka sirf ek bara aur bohat bal-khaya hua lumen hai jise cisternal space kehte hain. Yeh cell ke kul hajam ka 10 percent se zyada gherta hai. Cisternae do tahon wale nuclear envelope se bhi juri hain, is liye ER nucleus aur cytoplasm ke darmiyan pipeline ka kaam karta hai. ER cell ke andar aur bahar istemal ke liye kai qisam ke biochemical compounds banata, process karta aur pohanchata hai. ER do qisam ka hai: rough aur smooth.

Rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) ki satah ribosomes se dhaki hoti hai, is liye microscope mein yeh khurdari (bumpy) nazar aati hai. Yeh zyada tar proteins banane aur process karne ka kaam karti hai. Process karte waqt RER proteins mein doosre chemicals (jaise sugars) jorti hai. Phir RER tayyar proteins cell ke un hisson tak pohanchati hai jahan zaroorat ho, ya mazeed tabdeeli ke liye Golgi apparatus ko bhej deti hai.
Smooth ER un cells mein bohat zyada hoti hai jo lipid aur carbohydrate metabolism zyada karte hain (dimagh aur muscle) ya detoxification (zeher khatam karna) karte hain (jigar/liver).

blocks.alt: Rough ER ki ek cisterna: is ki bahari satah par ribosome barhti hui polypeptide ko membrane ke paar lumen mein dalta hai; andar protein par carbohydrate jora jata hai; teer protein ko lumen mein cisterna ke sire tak le jate hain jahan se transport vesicle toot kar (bud off) secretory protein ke saath aage chala jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16: Rough endoplasmic reticulum ka kaam (textbook ki Figure 3.16 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum (SER) ki satah par ribosomes nahi hote, is liye microscope mein yeh hamwar (even) nazar aati hai. Zyada tar cells mein yeh rough ER se bohat kam hoti hai. SER khaas taur par lipids banati hai, carbohydrate metabolism ke building blocks banati hai, aur dawaon aur zehron ka detoxification karti hai. SER calcium jama (store) kar ke aur calcium metabolism kar ke bhi cell ke kai kaamon mein hissa leti hai. Muscle cells mein SER calcium chhorti hai jis se muscle sukarta (contract hota) hai.
3- Ribosomes

Tamam zinda cells mein ribosomes hote hain. Yeh nanhe daanedar (granular) structures hain jo taqreeban 60 percent ribosomal RNA (rRNA) aur 40 percent protein se bane hain. Ribosomes membrane mein band nahi hote aur doosre organelles se bohat chhote hain. Eukaryotic cells mein ribosomes zyada tar rough ER se jure hote hain aur kuch azaad bikhre hote hain. Prokaryotic cells mein saare ribosomes cytoplasm mein azaad hote hain. Ribosomes cell ki protein banane wali machine hain. Yeh un cells mein sab se zyada hote hain jo protein bohat banate hain, jaise pancreas aur dimagh ke cells. Aam cell mein kai hazar ribosomes hote hain, lekin kuch cells mein kuch million tak.

Eukaryotic ribosomes nucleolus mein bante aur jurte hain. Ribosomal proteins nucleolus mein aa kar rRNA ke saath mil kar do ribosomal subunits (ek chhota, ek bara) banate hain. Yeh subunits nuclear pores se nucleus se bahar nikalte hain. Cytoplasm mein dono subunits protein banane ke liye jur jate hain. Jab protein nahi ban raha hota to dono subunits alag ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Ribosome jis mein bara subunit chhote subunit ke oopar baitha hai; mRNA ki lari dono subunits ke beech se guzarti hai aur ek barhti hui polypeptide, amino acids ke daanon ki zanjeer, bare subunit ke oopar se nikal rahi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.18: mRNA ko translate karta hua ribosome (textbook ki Figure 3.18 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Eukaryotic ribosome 80S hai: bara subunit 60S aur chhota 40S. Ribosome mRNA par aage barhta hai aur tRNA laaye hue amino acids ko jor kar polypeptide banata hai.

Ribosomes apni aam jaghon ke ilawa mitochondria aur podon ke chloroplasts ke andar bhi milte hain. Yeh ribosomes size aur banawat mein cytoplasm ke ribosomes se kafi mukhtalif hain aur prokaryotes ke ribosomes se zyada milte julte hain.

Protein banane ke liye rRNA ke ilawa do aur qisam ke RNA chahiye. Messenger RNA (mRNA) DNA se li hui hidayat (instructions) deta hai. Transfer RNA (tRNA) amino acids ribosome tak lata hai. Jab amino acids ki chain ban jati hai to ribosome use chhor deta hai.
Azaad (free) ribosomes jo proteins banate hain woh cell ke apne andar istemal ke liye hote hain. Jabke RER se jure ribosomes ke banaye proteins cell se bahar bheje jate hain.

Ribosome ke subunits ko un ki Svedberg (S) values se bayan kiya jata hai. Yeh values is par mabni hain ke centrifuge mein ghoomte waqt woh kitni tezi se neeche baithte hain (rate of sedimentation). Eukaryotic cell ka poora ribosome 80S hai: chhota subunit 40S aur bara subunit 60S. Prokaryotic cells mein 70S ribosomes hain, jin mein 30S aur 50S subunits hote hain.

Svedberg values jamaa (add) nahi hoteen, yani do subunits ki values ka jor poore ribosome ki value ke barabar nahi hota (40S + 60S = 80S, 100S nahi). Wajah yeh hai ke molecule ke neeche baithne ki raftaar us ke size aur shakal par munhasir hai, sirf us ke molecular weight par nahi.
4- Mitochondria

Mitochondria (wahid: mitochondrion) chhari (rod) jaise organelles hain jinhen cell ke power generators (bijli ghar) kaha jata hai. Mitochondrion do membranes se ghira hota hai. Dono membranes ke darmiyan ek tang intermembrane space hai. Andar wali membrane ke neeche ek bara hissa matrix kehlata hai. Bahar wali membrane hamwar hai aur chhalni (sieve) ki tarah bohat bare molecules ko rok leti hai. Andar wali membrane bohat bal-khayi hui hai aur andar ki taraf kai tahein (infoldings) banati hai jinhen cristae kehte hain; in se satah ka area barh jata hai.

Scientists ka khayal (hypothesis) hai ke mitochondria kaise bane: laakhon saal pehle chhote, azaad rehne wale prokaryotes ko bare prokaryotes ne nigal liya, magar hazam nahi kiya. Waqt ke saath dono mein symbiotic (ek doosre ko faida dene wala) rishta ban gaya: bara jandar chhote ko bharpoor nutrients deta tha aur chhota jandar bare ko ATP molecules deta tha.

Cristae ki andar ki satah par matrix ki taraf ghundi (knob) jaise ubhaar hain jinhen F-1 particles kehte hain. Yeh asal mein ATP-synthase enzymes hain. Andar wali membrane mein kuch aur complexes bhi hain jo electron transport chain mein electron carriers ka kaam karte hain. Mitochondria zyada tar doosre organelles se mukhtalif hain: mitochondrion ka apna circular (gol) DNA hai (prokaryotes ke DNA jaisa), har qisam ka RNA aur 70S ribosomes hain, aur yeh cell se alag khud replicate ho sakta hai.

Mitochondria cellular respiration ki jagah hain. Yeh oxygen aur nutrients se adenosine triphosphate (ATP) banate hain. ATP cell ki chemical energy ki "currency" hai jo cell ke metabolic kaam chalati hai. Matrix ke enzymes cellular respiration ke kuch marahil (steps), jaise Krebs cycle, chalate hain. Electron transport chain ke proteins andar wali membrane par hote hain.

Kisi cell mein mitochondria ki tadaad us cell ki metabolic zaroorat par munhasir hai: ek se le kar hazaron tak. Mitochondria taqreeban tamam eukaryotes, yani podon, janwaron, fungi aur protists, mein milte hain, aur itne bare hain ke light microscope se dekhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Mitochondrion ki lambi qash: hamwar outer membrane aur inner membrane, jin ke beech inter-membrane space hai. Inner membrane mur kar cristae banati hai jo matrix mein andar tak jati hain; cristae par chhote ghundi jaise F-1 particles hain (ek bara kar ke dikhaya gaya). Matrix mein DNA aur ribosomes hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.19: Mitochondrion ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.19 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Ribosomes, DNA, Matrix, Outer membrane, Inner membrane, Inter-membrane space, F-1 particle, Cristae.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cristae alag tukre nahin, balkeh inner membrane hi ki tahein (folds) hain; is se satah barh jati hai. F-1 particles (ATP synthase) cristae par hote hain aur yahin ATP banta hai.
5- Chloroplasts

Podon aur bohat se protists ke cells mein teen qisam ke plastids hain: chloroplasts, chromoplasts aur leucoplasts. Be-rang leucoplasts cheezen store karte hain aur peele se laal rang wale chromoplasts poday ke hisson ko rang dete hain.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Podon ki sab se aham khususiyat photosynthesis hai, yani roshni ki energy ko chemical energy mein badal kar apni ghiza khud banana. Yeh amal taqreeban har poday mein hota hai aur khaas organelles, chloroplasts, mein hota hai. Poday ke tamam hare hisson mein, tanay aur kachche phalon samet, chloroplasts hote hain, lekin zyada tar photosynthesis pattiyon (leaves) mein hota hai. Patti ki satah par aam taur par har square millimetre mein taqreeban paanch laakh (half million) chloroplasts hote hain. Chloroplasts mein chlorophyll "a" aur chlorophyll "b" pigments (rang) hain jo photosynthesis ke liye zaroori roshni ki energy jazb karte hain.

Ellipsoid (lamba-gol, ande jaisa) chloroplast do membranes mein band hai; dono membranes ke darmiyan ki jagah intermembrane space kehlati hai. Andar wali membrane ke andar ek semi-fluid madda stroma hai. Is mein ghule hue enzymes hain aur chloroplast ka zyada tar hajam yahi hai. Bahar wali membrane andar wali se kahin zyada permeable hai.

Andar ki membranes ek doosre ke bohat qareeb hoti hain aur kinaron par jur jati hain. Is tarah do saath wali membranes mil kar ek disk (tikki) jaisa khana banati hain jise thylakoid kehte hain. Bohat se thylakoids ke dher (stacks) grana (wahid: granum) kehlate hain. Lamellae woh ghair-hare hisse hain jo do grana ko jorte hain. Har granum mein chand se le kar kai thylakoids ho sakte hain, aur ek chloroplast mein sau ya zyada grana. Mitochondrion ki tarah chloroplast bhi doosre organelles se mukhtalif hai, kyun ke is ka apna DNA hai aur yeh cell se alag khud reproduce karta hai.

Mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein mushabihat (similarity) hai. Dono cell ke liye energy ko ek shakal se doosri mein badalte hain. Mitochondria aerobic respiration karte hain: oxygen ki madad se sugars, fats aur doosre chemical fuels ko tor kar ATP ki shakal mein chemical energy banate hain. Chloroplasts photosynthesis karte hain: sooraj ki energy se carbon dioxide aur pani istemal kar ke organic nutrients banate hain. Mitochondria ki tarah chloroplasts ka bhi apna DNA hai aur yeh cell se alag barh aur reproduce ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Chloroplast ki lambi qash: outer membrane aur inner membrane stroma ko gherti hain. Andar disc jaise thylakoids ke dher grana banate hain; har thylakoid ke andar lumen hai, aur chapti stroma lamellae ek granum ko doosre se jorti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.20: Chloroplast ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.20 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Thylakoid ki membrane mein chlorophyll hai jahan roshni pakri jati hai; thylakoid ke andar ki jagah lumen hai. Stroma thylakoids ke bahar ka maada hai jahan glucose banta hai. Chloroplast mein apna circular DNA aur ribosomes bhi hote hain, magar woh is figure mein label nahin.

Roshni thylakoid disks mein jure chlorophyll molecules jazb karte hain. Roshni jazb kar ke yeh chlorophyll molecules electrons chhorte hain, aur is tarah ATP banta hai. Phir stroma mein in ATP ki madad se kam energy wali carbon dioxide ko zyada energy wale compound, jaise glucose, mein badla jata hai.
6- Golgi Apparatus
Golgi apparatus Camillo Golgi ne daryaft kiya.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Golgi apparatus paanch se aath pyali (cup) jaise, membrane se dhake thailon par mushtamil hai jinhen cisternae kehte hain; yeh ek doosre ke oopar tah-dar (stacked) hote hain. Yeh podon, janwaron aur unicellular eukaryotes ke cells mein milta hai. Kuch unicellular flagellates mein Golgi apparatus mein 60 cisternae tak ho sakti hain. Isi tarah ek cell mein Golgi apparatuses ki tadaad us ke kaam ke mutabiq badalti hai. Janwar ke cells mein aam taur par das se bees Golgi stacks hote hain. Yeh complex aam taur par nucleus ke qareeb hota hai.

Camillo Golgi ek nayi staining technique (Golgi staining) se nervous system parh rahe the. Unhon ne cells ke andar ek structure dekha aur us ka naam reticular apparatus rakha. 1898 mein unhon ne apni daryaft ka elaan kiya, aur yeh structure un ke naam par Golgi apparatus kehlaya. Bohat se scientists ne nahi mana ke yeh asal organelle hai; un ka kehna tha ke yeh staining se paida hone wala nazar ka dhoka hai. Beeswin (20th) sadi mein electron microscope ki ijaad ne aakhir kar sabit kar diya ke Golgi apparatus waqai cell ka organelle hai.
Har Golgi stack ke do alag rukh (faces) hain. 'Cis' face ER ke qareeb hai aur 'trans' face plasma membrane ke qareeb.

Golgi apparatus cell ki chemical mahsoolat (products) ka distribution aur shipping department hai. Yeh ER mein bane proteins aur lipids mein tabdeeli (modify) karta hai aur unhen cell se bahar bhejne ya cell ki doosri jaghon par pohanchane ke liye tayyar karta hai.

Proteins, carbohydrates, phospholipids aur doosre molecules wale chhote vesicles (thailiyan) ER se alag ho kar nikalte hain. Yeh vesicles cytoplasm mein chalte hue Golgi apparatus ke 'cis' face tak pohanchte hain, Golgi se jur jate hain aur apne molecules us mein chhor dete hain. Yahan in compounds par mazeed kaam hota hai: Golgi lumen ke enzymes inhen glycoproteins aur glycolipids mein badal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Golgi apparatus khameeda cisternae ka dher, har ek ke andar lumen. ER se aane wale vesicles oopar cis face tak pohanchte hain; neeche trans face se secretory vesicles bante hain, plasma membrane tak jate hain, us se mil kar apna secretion cell se bahar chhor dete hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.21: Golgi apparatus ki banawat aur kaam (textbook ki Figure 3.21 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Incoming vesicle (from ER), Cis face, Lumen, Cisternae, Trans face, Secretory vesicle, Plasma membrane, Secretion.

blocks.text: Tayyar product Golgi ke 'trans' face se ek vesicle mein bahar nikalta hai aur cell ke andar ya bahar apni manzil par bheja jata hai. Cell se bahar bheje jane wale products secretions kehlate hain. Kuch products wapas ER ko lautaye jate hain ya pak kar (mature ho kar) lysosomes ban jate hain. Is ke ilawa podon ke cells mein Golgi apparatus pectin aur doosre polysaccharides banata hai jo poday ki banawat aur metabolism ke liye zaroori hain.
7- Lysosomes
Lysosomes Belgian scientist Christian René de Duve ne daryaft kiye. In mein taqatwar hazam karne wale (digestive) enzymes hote hain.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Lysosomes gol organelles hain jo ek membrane se ghire hain. Yeh cell ke hazam karne wale khane (digestive compartments) hain. Lysosomes zyada tar eukaryotic cells mein milte hain. Janwaron mein yeh beemari se larne wale cells, jaise white blood cells, mein sab se zyada hote hain, kyun ke white blood cells ko bacteria, viruses aur doosre bahar se aane wale hamla-awaron ko hazam karna hota hai.

Lysosomes cell ki un cheezon ko bhi torte hain jin ki umar poori ho chuki ho ya jo ab kaam ki na hon. Is kaam ko autophagy (cell ka apne hisse khud hazam karna) kehte hain. Lysosomes cell ke waste, fats, carbohydrates, proteins aur doosre bare molecules ko saada compounds mein tor dete hain, jo wapas cytoplasm mein nayi cheezen banane ke liye bhej diye jate hain.

Cell lysosomes ke enzymes se mehfooz rehta hai. In enzymes ko acidic (tezabi) mahol chahiye (pH taqreeban 4.8). Lysosome ke andar ka madda acidic hai, lekin cytosol neutral hai. Is liye agar lysosome phat bhi jaye to us ke enzymes cytosol mein be-asar (inactive) ho jate hain aur cell ko nuqsan nahi hota.

blocks.alt: Gol lysosome jo ek membrane mein band hai jis par membrane proteins jure hain, aur andar hydrolytic enzymes hain. Bara kiya gaya daira membrane ko lipid bilayer ki shakal mein dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.22: Lysosome ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Lysosomes mein taqreeban 40 mukhtalif hydrolytic (pani ki madad se torne wale) enzymes hote hain. Yeh sab ER mein bante hain aur Golgi apparatus mein tayyar (modify) hote hain. Lysosome ki membrane cell ke baqi hisson ko in sakht digestive enzymes se bachati hai, warna yeh cell ko bohat nuqsan pohanchate.

blocks.alt: Plasma membrane ke qareeb cell ke andar: rough endoplasmic reticulum transport vesicle ko Golgi apparatus bhejta hai, jis se lysosomes bante hain. Phagocytosis se andar liya gaya zarra (particle) ek vacuole banata hai jo lysosome se mil kar secondary lysosome banta hai, jahan digestion hota hai. Purana cell component autophagosome mein band ho kar lysosome se milta hai aur hazam ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.23: Phagocytosis se liye gaye zarre aur cell ke hisson ko torne mein lysosome ka kirdar (textbook ki Figure 3.23 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Plasma membrane, Rough endoplasmic reticulum, Transport vesicle, Particle, Phagocytosis, Lysosome, Autophagosome, Cell component, Secondary lysosome, Digestion.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Raasta yaad rakhein: ER mein enzymes bante hain, Golgi unhein tayyar karta hai, lysosome ban kar nikalta hai, phir bahar se aaye zarre (phagocytosis) ya cell ke apne purane hisse (autophagy) ko hazam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Textbook ki figure mein ek label 'Lysome' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Lysosome' hai, aur drawing mein yahi likha gaya hai.

20th sadi ke darmiyan (mid-20th century) mein Belgian scientist Christian René de Duve jigar (liver) ke cells mein carbohydrate metabolism parh rahe the. Unhon ne dekha ke jab centrifuge mein cells toot jate hain to woh acid phosphatase enzyme chhorte hain. Unhon ne andaza lagaya ke yeh digestive enzyme cell ke andar kisi membrane mein band organelle mein hai, aur us ka naam lysosome rakha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "mid-18th century" (18th sadi ka darmiyan) likhti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: Christian de Duve (1917–2013) ne yeh kaam 20th sadi ke darmiyan mein kiya; 1949 mein jigar ke cells mein acid phosphatase dekha aur 1955 mein lysosome ka naam rakha.

Lysosomal storage diseases mein mareez mein lysosome ka koi ek hydrolytic enzyme nahi hota. Aisa lysosome na hazam hone wali cheezon se bhar jata hai, jo cell ke kaam mein rukawat dalti hain. Misal: Pompe's disease mein lysosome mein glycogen hazam karne wala enzyme nahi hota, is liye jigar ke cells mein nuqsan-deh had tak glycogen jama ho jata hai. Tay-Sachs disease mein lipid hazam karne wala ek zaroori enzyme nahi hota. Dimagh ke nerve cells mein yeh lipids jama ho kar nervous system ko nuqsan pohanchate hain, zehni kamzori (mental retardation) paida karte hain aur bachpan hi mein maut ka sabab bante hain.

Aap ke dimagh ke bohat se cells nashonuma (development) ke dauran mar jate hain. Yeh tay-shuda khudkushi (directed suicide) un cells ke andar lysosomes ke phatne se hoti hai jinhen khatam karna hota hai.

Lysosomes poore cell ko khatam karne mein bhi kaam aate hain. Kuch cells ko chun kar khatam karna (selective cell death) multicellular jandaron ki nashonuma ka hissa hai. Misal: jab tadpole (mendak ka bachcha) mendak banta hai to us ki dum ke cells lysosomes ke enzymes se khatam ho jate hain.
8- Peroxisomes
Peroxisomes tamam eukaryotic cells mein paye jane wale organelles hain jo ek membrane se ghire hain. Inhen bhi Christian de Duve ne daryaft kiya, jinhon ne lysosomes daryaft kiye the.

Peroxisomes mein kai qisam ke enzymes hote hain. In mein se bohat se oxidative hain, yani oxidation karte hain: electrons aur hydrogens ko hatate hain. Yeh enzymes khaas taur par cell ko zehreele maddon se pak karte hain. Kuch peroxisomes, jaise jigar ke cells wale, alcohol aur doosre nuqsan-deh compounds ko oxidise kar ke be-zehr (detoxify) karte hain.
Kuch peroxisomes mein catalase enzyme hota hai jo hydrogen peroxide (cell ke metabolism ki ek aam zimni paidawar, by-product) ko pani aur oxygen mein tor deta hai:

blocks.alt: Peroxisome jo proteins wali ek membrane mein band hai; andar daanedar matrix aur enzyme urate oxidase ka gehra crystal jaisa markaz (core) hai. Bara kiya gaya daira membrane ko lipid bilayer dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.24: Peroxisome ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.24 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andar ka gehra crystal urate oxidase enzyme ka hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Textbook ki figure is membrane ko 'Plasma Membrane' kehti hai, magar yeh peroxisome ki apni ek tah wali membrane hai, cell ki plasma membrane nahin; drawing mein sirf 'Membrane' likha gaya hai.

Peroxisomes ki kharabi se kai metabolic beemariyan hoti hain. In mein sab se sangeen Zellweger syndrome hai, jis mein cells mein peroxisomes bilkul nahi hote ya bohat kam hote hain. Yeh congenital (paidaishi) beemari hai; is ka koi ilaj nahi aur aam taur par pehle saal hi mein maut ho jati hai.
9- Glyoxysomes

Glyoxysomes peroxisomes jaise hain lekin sirf poday ke cells mein milte hain. In mein woh enzymes hain jo lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain. Yeh lipid (tel) se bharpoor beejon, jaise castor beans aur soyabeans, ke cells mein sab se zyada hote hain. Beej ugne (germination) ke waqt yeh jama shuda lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain jo ugne ke liye energy dete hain.
10- Vacuoles

Vacuoles maye (fluid) se bhare, ek membrane wale organelles hain. Cells ke cytoplasm mein bohat si chhoti vacuoles hoti hain. Lekin jab poday ka cell jawan (mature) hota hai to us ki chhoti vacuoles jur kar ek bari vacuole ban jati hain.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Vacuoles membrane mein band thaile hain jo kai tarah kaam karte hain. Misal ke taur par jawan poday ke cells mein ek bari vacuole banawati sahara deti hai, aur cheezen store karne, waste thikane lagane, hifazat aur growth ke kaam bhi karti hai. Janwar ke cells ki vacuoles bohat chhoti hoti hain aur zyada tar cheezen thori der store karne ya ek jagah se doosri jagah le jane ke kaam aati hain.

Poday ke bohat se cells mein ek bari central vacuole hoti hai jo chhoti vacuoles ke jurne se ahista ahista banti hai. Yeh cell ki zyada tar jagah (80 percent ya zyada) gherti hai. Poday ke cell ki vacuole ek membrane mein band hoti hai jise tonoplast kehte hain. Vacuole ke andar ka madda cell sap kehlata hai, jo aas paas ke cytoplasm se bohat mukhtalif hota hai.
Poday ki vacuoles mein jama hone wali kai cheezen insanon ke kaam ki hain, jaise opium (afeem), rubber aur lehsan ka zaiqa (garlic flavouring).

Central vacuole poday ki banawat mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yeh kirdar us ki turgor pressure ko control karne ki salahiyat se juda hai. Turgor pressure (andar ke pani ka deewar par dabao) cell ko sakht (rigid) banata hai.

Behtareen halaat mein poday ko kafi pani milta hai aur us ke cells ki central vacuoles pani jama hone se phool jati hain. Is se turgor pressure zyada ho jata hai, jo cell wall ke sahare ke saath poday ki banawat ko mazboot rakhta hai. Vacuoles aksar woh pigments bhi store karti hain jo kuch phoolon ko rang dete hain; yeh rang shehad ki makhiyon aur doosre pollinators (zar-gul pohanchane wale) ko apni taraf khenchte hain. Vacuoles aise molecules bhi chhorti hain jo kai keeron aur janwaron ke liye zehreele hain, is tarah woh poday ko khane se baaz rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Poday ke cell ka hissa: cell sap se bhari bari central vacuole jis ki membrane tonoplast hai, aur us ke gird chloroplasts wala cytoplasm.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.25: Poday ke cell mein vacuole ki banawat (textbook ki Figure 3.25 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: 11- Centrioles
Centrioles khokhle (hollow) aur cylinder jaise organelles hain. Ek centriole microtubules ke nau (9) triplets se bana hai.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Janwaron aur zyada tar protists ke cells mein centrioles woh organelles hain jo cytoskeleton ke fibres, yani microtubules (spindle fibres samet), ko jorne aur tarteeb dene se jure hain.

Eukaryotic cells mein centrioles jore (pairs) mein hote hain. Dono centrioles nuclear envelope ke qareeb ek doosre se seedhe zaviye (right angle, 90°) par hote hain. Cilia ya flagella wale cells mein centrioles cilia aur flagella banane mein hissa lete hain. Har cilium aur flagellum ek centriole par jama hota hai jise basal body kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do centrioles jo aapas mein seedhe zaviye (right angle) par hain: ek saamne se nau microtubule triplets ka challa dikhata hai, doosra khara hua khokhla belan (cylinder) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.26: Do centrioles (textbook ki Figure 3.26 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Podon aur fungi ke cells mein centrioles aur basal bodies nahi hote; un ke microtubules aur spindle fibres cytoplasm ki doosri structures se tarteeb pate hain.
12- Cytoskeleton
Cytoskeleton cytoplasm mein protein fibres ka jaal hai. Is mein yeh fibres shamil hain:

items: Microfilaments: yeh tamam eukaryotic cells mein hote hain. Microfilaments thos (solid) charhiyan (rods) hain jo ek globular (gol) protein actin se bani hain. Yeh toot kar dobara jur sakte hain, aur is tarah cell ko shakal badalne aur harkat karne mein madad dete hain. Microfilaments divide hote cell ko do cells mein alag (pinch off) hone mein bhi madad dete hain. Myosin ke saath mil kar yeh cell ke sukarne (contraction) mein madad karte hain.

Microtubules: yeh seedhe, khokhle cylinders hain jo subunits se bane hain. Har subunit do mukhtalif tubulin proteins, alpha-tubulin aur beta-tubulin, se bana hai. Microtubules cell ko banawat aur shakal dete hain aur organelles ke safar ke liye sarkon (highways) ka kaam karte hain. Yeh cilia aur flagella ka bara hissa hain aur cell division mein spindle fibres banane mein hissa lete hain.

Intermediate filaments: yeh sirf kuch higher (taraqqi yafta) janwaron ke groups mein hote hain. Yeh mukhtalif proteins se bante hain, lekin sab se aam protein subunit vimentin hai. Kuch cells ke intermediate filaments doosre proteins se bane hote hain, jaise skin (jild) ke cells mein keratin. Intermediate filaments cell ki shakal aur sakhti qaim rakhte hain aur nucleus samet kai organelles ko apni jagah jamaye rakhte hain.

blocks.text: 13- Cilia and Flagella

Cilium (jama: cilia) aur flagellum (jama: flagella) harkat ke liye locomotor appendages (cell se bahar nikle hisse) hain jo kuch cells se nikalte hain. Yeh cell ki body se nikli hui patli, dum jaisi banawatein hain. Cilia chhote aur aam taur par bohat zyada hote hain, jabke flagella lambe magar kam hote hain. Podon mein cilia shaz-o-nadir hote hain. Bohat se protozoans (ciliates) mein cilia hote hain. Mammals jaise bare eukaryotes ke kuch cells ki satah par cilia hote hain; misal ke taur par insan ki trachea (saans ki nali) ki andar ki tah mein cilia hain jo balgham (mucus) aur gard ko saans ki naliyon se bahar dhakelte hain.

Eukaryotic cilia aur flagella ka markazi hissa (core) axoneme kehlata hai. Is mein darmiyan mein do microtubules hain jin ke gird nau (9) doublet microtubules ka ek bahari ghera hai. Axoneme ke ghere par dynein molecules lage hain jo saath wale microtubule doublets ke darmiyan pul (bridge) banate hain. Biologists is tarteeb ko "9 + 2" structure kehte hain. Poore axoneme ke gird plasma membrane hoti hai. Cilium ki jar mein us ka organising centre, basal body, hota hai. Basal body ki banawat axoneme ke bahari ghere jaisi hai, lekin us ke nau sets mein har set doublet ke bajaye teen microtubules (triplet) ka hai. Basal body asal mein centriole hi hai. Prokaryotic flagella ki banawat bilkul mukhtalif hai; woh protein flagellin se bane hain.

blocks.alt: Cell ki satah ke neeche basal body se nikalta hua cilium, plasma membrane se dhaka hua, jis mein microtubules chalti hain aur kate hue sire par dynein arms nazar aate hain. Saath mein axoneme ki qash: nau bahari microtubule doublets dynein arms ke saath, radial spokes se do central microtubules ke gird ghilaf (sheath) se jure hue, sab plasma membrane ke andar.

blocks.prompt: Inhen ek membrane, do membrane aur be-membrane banawat mein baanten: ribosome, lysosome, mitochondrion, Golgi apparatus, chloroplast, centriole, peroxisome, nucleus, vacuole.
blocks.explanation: Ek membrane: lysosome, Golgi apparatus, peroxisome, vacuole. Do membranes: mitochondrion, chloroplast, nucleus. Koi membrane nahin: ribosome, centriole.

blocks.prompt: Ek secretory protein ka rasta us ke banne se cell se nikalne tak tarteeb se banawat ke naam le kar bayan karen.
blocks.explanation: Rough ER par ribosomes protein banate hain, jo cisternal space mein dakhil ho kar wahan process hota hai (sugars shamil). Yeh transport vesicle mein Golgi apparatus ke cis face tak jata hai, cisternae se guzarte hue glycoprotein mein badalta hai, trans face par secretory vesicle mein pack hota hai, aur vesicle plasma membrane se mil kar exocytosis se secretion bahar chhorti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Cell wall: middle lamella (pectates) pehle banti hai, primary wall (cellulose, hemicellulose, pectin), kuch cells mein secondary wall (lignin); plasmodesmata parosi poday ke cells ko jorte hain. Fungi chitin, bacteria peptidoglycan, diatoms silica istemal karte hain.

Plasma membrane (fluid mosaic model, Singer aur Nicolson 1972): phospholipid bilayer jis mein proteins tairte hain, rawani ke liye cholesterol, pehchan ke nishan ke taur par glycoproteins aur glycolipids (glycocalyx); neem-masamdar rukawat.

Nucleus: pore complexes wali do-tah envelope, nuclear lamina, nucleoplasm, chromatin (histones par DNA, nucleosomes) jo chromosomes (chromatids aur centromere) mein dabta hai, nucleolus jo NORs par ribosomal subunits banata hai. Chromosomes ki tadaad nasl ke mutabiq hai aur pecheedgi se juri nahin.

ER: rough (ribosomes, proteins) aur smooth (lipids, detoxification, calcium); ek cisternal space jo nuclear envelope se jari hai. Ribosomes: rRNA aur protein, eukaryotes mein 80S (40S + 60S), prokaryotes mein 70S (30S + 50S).

Mitochondria (cristae, F1 particles, matrix, apna DNA, 70S ribosomes) respiration se ATP banate hain; chloroplasts (thylakoids, grana, lamellae, stroma, apna DNA) photosynthesis se glucose banate hain.

Golgi apparatus mahsoolat badalta aur bhejta hai (cis se trans); lysosomes hazam karte hain (taqreeban 40 enzymes, tezabi); peroxisomes zehreele madde oxidise karte hain (catalase); glyoxysomes beejon mein lipids ko carbohydrates banate hain; vacuoles zakheera aur turgor deti hain.

Centrioles (nau triplets, seedhe zaviye par jore) microtubules tarteeb dete aur basal bodies ke taur par cilia aur flagella ko jamate hain; cytoskeleton mein microfilaments (actin), microtubules (tubulin) aur intermediate filaments (vimentin, keratin) hain; cilia aur flagella ka 9 + 2 axoneme hai.
